scenes.title: Beyond the price
scenes.viewerPurpose: Notice something still scarce when essentials are guaranteed Enter two linked futures built around that question
scenes.composition: A secure household looks onto an undecided public project
addOrChange: Remove mourning cloth and later infant revelations, adding ordinary food and shelter.

cues.narration: Food and housing are guaranteed, but the right to reshape the world is still scarce.
cues.visualAction: Show essentials available while the larger project remains contested.

cues.narration: The Substrate Cycle explores that future through two linked speculative novels.
cues.visualAction: Introduce two linked volumes beside the household view.

scenes.title: The right to build
scenes.viewerPurpose: Understand how helping society earns influence Question power earned by earlier service
scenes.composition: A respected contributor presents a waterfront plan to a resident
addOrChange: Remove final promenade and flooding outcomes, retaining one affected home.

cues.narration: People gain influence by solving the problems everyone depends on.
cues.visualAction: Place an earlier contribution beside the new public proposal.

cues.narration: How much say should a past achievement give someone over another person’s life?
cues.visualAction: The resident points to the home that would bear the consequence.

scenes.title: Who carries the future
scenes.viewerPurpose: See the dilemma tested through family and planetary life Remember children cannot choose the consequences they inherit
scenes.composition: A caring household considers a long-range project affecting a child
addOrChange: Remove later plot clues, games and formal standing calculations.

cues.narration: Families, changing ecosystems, and plans for whole planets put that question to the test.
cues.visualAction: Widen from household care to a modest ecosystem plan.

cues.narration: Children inherit consequences they cannot yet vote on or refuse.
cues.visualAction: The adults consider consequences the child cannot yet choose.

scenes.title: Power beneath abundance
scenes.viewerPurpose: Want to see what abundance leaves undecided Imagine someone gaining a lasting say over your life
scenes.composition: The linked novels connect public projects with private lives
addOrChange: Remove elaborate tab choreography and any settlement or catastrophe reveal.

cues.narration: These stories make abundance feel rich with possibility and full of unfinished political choices.
cues.visualAction: Keep appealing possibilities beside an unsettled household question.

cues.narration: In this future, a gift to society might give someone a lasting say over your life.
cues.visualAction: End on the old contribution beside the affected home.
